title: 秋丽
appearance: Loose pale grey-green rosettes with long narrow pointed fleshy leaves, faint peach blush, gradually branching stems

title: 蒂亚
appearance: Compact glossy green spoon-pointed leaves, vivid scarlet-red leaf margins and tips, short branching rosettes

title: 蓝石莲
appearance: Broad flattened powder-blue spoon leaves, low symmetrical layered rosette, subtle pink-purple outer edges

title: 蓝姬莲
appearance: Small tightly packed blue-grey rosettes with many tiny pointed narrow leaves and fine rose-red tips

title: 乙女心
appearance: Upright short stalks bearing plump elongated club-shaped jade-green leaves, blunt pink-red ends, no flat lotus petals

title: 虹之玉
appearance: Upright branching stems with short very round jelly-bean leaves, green bases and cherry-red rounded tops

title: 千佛手
appearance: Long tapered plump banana-like light green to yellow leaves packed into small upright pointed clusters

title: 铭月
appearance: Golden yellow-orange pointed thick leaves in open rosettes on short upright stems

title: 猎户座
appearance: Symmetrical broad spoon-leaf rosettes, silvery blue-purple leaves with distinct pastel pink-purple tips

title: 马库斯
appearance: Small compact olive-green rosettes, pointed thick spoon leaves with warm orange-red tips, short branching stems

title: 艾伦
appearance: Very plump rounded blue-green to lavender-pink egg-shaped leaves in a compact loose rosette

title: 劳尔
appearance: Powdered blue-green short club-shaped oval thick leaves, compact branching clusters with tiny orange-red tips

title: 冰玉
appearance: Plump broad rounded pale jade-green leaves with a softly luminous smooth waxy surface and delicate pink tips

title: 巧克力方砖
appearance: Compact rosettes of broad spoon-shaped glossy chocolate-brown leaves, dark burgundy edges, green young center

title: 碧桃
appearance: Broad rounded spoon-shaped yellow-green leaves with peach-orange margins, loose full rosettes

title: 乌木
appearance: Firm pointed triangular green succulent leaves, striking near-black burgundy border and tip, tight agave-like rosette

title: 蓝精灵
appearance: Small blue-green powdery pointed oval rosettes on short slender upright branching stems, coral red tips

title: 水蜜桃
appearance: Dense broad pointed pale mint rosette leaves with soft peach-pink broad tip areas, clearly thick leaf planes

title: 昂斯诺
appearance: Compact yellow-green spoon leaves, broad rounded ends, orange-pink edges, a dense cabbage-like low rosette

title: 蓝苹果
appearance: Small short-leaf compact blue-green rosette, round oval leaf bodies with abruptly pointed red ends

title: 淡雪
appearance: Loose rosettes of pale cream-grey elongated pointed thick leaves with gentle peach-pink tips, branching stems

title: 蓝松
appearance: Upright thin pale silver-blue cylindrical finger-like succulent leaves in tufts; many slim blue rods, no round beads

title: 球松
appearance: Tiny green dense pine-like heads of narrow needle-shaped fleshy leaves on short branching stems; miniature shrub shape

title: 火祭
appearance: UPRIGHT red succulent with triangular pointed thick leaves in opposite stacked pairs along vertical branching stems, green inner leaves, bright scarlet upper leaves

title: 吸财树
appearance: UPRIGHT miniature jade shrub with plump green tubular trumpet leaves, concave cup-like red-tinted ends, short stout branched woody base in late stages

title: 山地玫瑰
appearance: Dense green rose-bud-shaped rosette of many rounded spoon leaves curved inward, like a partially closed rose; short basal offsets, not red-tipped spiky leaves

title: 蛛丝卷绢
appearance: Compact pointed green rosettes tinged red, fine white cobweb threads distinctly spanning leaf tips and covering the small central crown

title: 毛汉尼
appearance: Single short rounded globose or truncated living-stone body, smooth translucent green-ochre to wine-red top, tiny central fissure, no strongly branched brown Lithops patterns

title: 帝玉
appearance: One stout pair of broad grey-green opposite rock-like leaves with flattened rounded tops, deep central cleft and tiny dark speckles; low green living stone

title: 草玉露
appearance: Many narrow pointed green fleshy leaves, small translucent windowed tips with fine dark green vertical veins, delicate thin leaf-tip hairs

title: 冰灯玉露
appearance: Large rounded inflated clear pale green leaf tips, wide smooth highly translucent windows, bright restrained glassy highlights, dense low rosette

title: 黑肌玉露
appearance: Very dark green to smoky brown-purple fleshy leaf bodies with clear smoky translucent rounded windows and pale fine veins

title: 赤线玉露
appearance: Clear green rounded fleshy leaf windows with distinctive fine red-burgundy longitudinal lines, not solid red leaves

title: 蓝镜玉露
appearance: Broad round pale blue-green leaves, very wide mirror-like transparent windows with delicate dark blue-green veins

title: 白莲花玉露
appearance: Pale whitish mint-green pointed thick leaves forming a low lotus-like rosette; translucent triangular windows with fine grey-green veins

title: 黄金玉露
appearance: Golden lime-yellow fleshy leaf bodies with some green streaks and clear pale yellow-green rounded windows; luminous yellow-green rosette

title: 樱水晶玉露
appearance: Longer narrow pale green translucent leaves ending in fine pointed tips, fine window veins and very subtle pink blush; crystal-like spiky rosette

title: 条纹十二卷
appearance: Firm upright pointed DARK GREEN opaque triangular leaves, conspicuous raised WHITE HORIZONTAL stripes on outer surfaces; no false glassy windows

title: 玉扇
appearance: Very thick rectangular-topped succulent leaves arranged in TWO OPPOSING ROWS forming a fan, flat translucent truncated tops with pale reticulated window lines; NOT a circular rosette

title: 水晶寿
appearance: Broad thick triangular green leaves with flat translucent triangular top windows, distinct thin vein lines, a low star-like rosette

title: 月影寿
appearance: Wide pale cream-mint triangular thick leaves, softly translucent triangular windows, faint grey-green veins, broad low rosette

title: 招财手
appearance: Green flat oval cactus pads growing upright and branching like raised hands, evenly spaced little white-gold glochid tufts on visible areoles

title: 小仙人球
appearance: Small GREEN round globular cactus with 10 to 14 clear vertical ribs and evenly spaced pale short starburst spines on areoles, no leaf rosette

title: 万重山
appearance: Cluster of different-height upright green five-ribbed columnar cactus towers like a miniature castle, small pale areoles and short tidy spines

title: 金手指
appearance: Several small upright finger-like green cactus columns thickly covered in orderly fine gold-yellow radial spines; clear individual cylinders

title: 白鸟
appearance: Compact small round cactus balls densely covered in delicate WHITE FEATHERY radial spines, soft feather-like texture over a green globular body, no cotton blobs

title: 九尾狐
appearance: Long slender cylindrical cactus stems covered in fine LONG WHITE SOFT HAIRS, older stems arch downward in a few separate furry tails; never nine animal tails

title: 钱串
appearance: Opposite paired thick triangular mint-green leaves tightly STACKED around slender upright stems, square coin-like pagoda chains with fine pink edges

title: 鹿角海棠
appearance: Upright branching stems with paired fleshy triangular blue-green leaves that diverge like short deer antlers, no round bead strings

title: 熊童子
appearance: Upright branching small shrub, plump fat green bear-paw leaves covered in very fine white hairs, each leaf end has 3 to 7 dark reddish-brown claw teeth

title: 宽叶不死鸟
appearance: Upright succulent with broad fleshy triangular green leaves, scalloped notched leaf edges; from adult stage many tiny rooted green plantlets along BOTH leaf margins

title: 棒叶不死鸟
appearance: Upright succulent with narrow cylindrical mottled green-brown fleshy leaves in whorls; from adult stage clusters of tiny green plantlets AT LEAF ENDS, not all along the cylindrical sides

title: 窄叶不死鸟
appearance: Upright branching succulent with long narrow lanceolate mottled green fleshy leaves, from adult stage many tiny plantlets along serrated leaf MARGINS, narrower than broad-leaf form
